# empty-body-live-delivery-wiring — analysis (generated by analyst on 2026-08-08)

## Problem

M1-794's empty-body guard sits on a new seam —
`OutboundDelivery.deliverLlmReply` (OutboundDelivery.java:147-154) — that
**no production code calls** (grep for `deliverLlmReply` over
`infochat-provider/src/main` returns only the definition; the only callers
are tests, OutboundDeliveryTest.java:398,419). The live chat reply still
flows through the M1-607 self-delivering path with no refusal of an
emptied body, so a markers-only LLM reply — `sanitize()` returns `""`,
pinned by
`LlmOutputSanitizerPostconditionTest.deletionShapesMatchTheirDocumentedPostconditions`
(LlmOutputSanitizerPostconditionTest.java:275-279) — is delivered to the
user today.

Reproduced RED on main, log `.scratch/tick-repro-M1-795-red2.log`
(:4351-4516, verified): `EmptyLlmReplyDeliveryIT.aMarkersOnlyReplyIsNeverDeliveredEmptied`
fails with the delivered finalized body `<\n\nNot based on your feed
posts; answered from general knowledge.>` — the user receives a message
whose only content is the provenance boilerplate; the LLM-authored
portion shipped empty. OBSERVED-SENT in the same log (:4466) confirms the
placeholder ("Working on it...") was sent first, i.e. the live leg
exercised is the placeholder finalize. The parked test is at
`.scratch/parked-for-M1-795/EmptyLlmReplyDeliveryIT.java` (read in full;
mirrors `InboundRouterChatModeIT`'s harness).

Source: M1-794's round-1 review RECOMMENDED-NEW-TICKET, quoted verbatim
in the merged ticket's Review-observations section
(docs/plan/m1/tick-tickets/M1-794-empty-body-delivery-guard.md:155-168).

## Root cause

Fully proven:

1. The M1-789 scaffolding strip made whole-reply emptying possible
   (`sanitize("<<<END id=\"x\">>>") == ""`, pinned at
   LlmOutputSanitizerPostconditionTest.java:278).
2. M1-794 added the refusal seam but — deliberately, per its own
   clarity_check (:61-70) — wired NO live path: the placeholder-finalize
   leg cannot simply refuse without leaving the D31 placeholder dangling,
   so wiring was scoped out to a follow-up that never got filed until
   now.
3. The chat path composes and delivers the emptied body unconditionally
   (ChatAgent.java:566-571 verbatim for en; InboundRouter.java:1962
   composition; StageProgressNotifier.java:339/:353 delivery), so the
   emptied reply reaches the user as `""` (clarify turn) or
   `"\n\n"+notice` (normal turn — red-log verified).

## Pitfalls

- **P1 — The deterministic-empty exemption must survive (carried from
  M1-794 P1).** A deliberately empty deterministic reply stays
  deliverable; refusal keys off the LLM-authored surface only. Bites any
  wiring placed too low: guarding `OutboundDelivery.deliver`,
  `terminate`'s generic legs, or `sendReply` would subject deterministic
  command output (docs/spec/llm.md §Failure handling surface;
  security.md §LLM output sanitizer exemption, :360-361) to the refusal.
  Mitigation: wire ONLY `deliverFresh` (whose bytes are LLM-prose-bearing
  /summary sections); leave `deliver`, `terminate`, `sendReply` untouched.
- **P2 — Refusing the placeholder finalize leaves a dangling D31
  placeholder.** messaging.md §Progress notifications (:220-222):
  "placeholders are never left dangling" — finalize + typing-off are
  guaranteed. The user is already looking at "Working on it..."; a
  refused finalize strands it forever. The placeholder leg needs
  SUBSTITUTION, never refusal. This is the open design question, answered
  in Chosen approach.
- **P3 — A router-level substitute would persist the emptied turn.**
  Substituting in `dispatchChatSelfDelivering` (after `dispatchChat`
  stashed the pending commit, InboundRouter.java:1947-1949) leaves the
  emptied assistant text committed to `chat_session` — the inverse of the
  M1-607 "as if never generated" property and of security.md §Failure
  handling's "the turn is discarded with no `chat_session` advance, no
  `chat_memory` write" (:1564-1566). Mitigation: the degrade happens
  INSIDE ChatAgent with a null `pendingCommit`, mirroring the
  refusal-intercept shape (ChatAgent.java:555-557).
- **P4 — GREEN-BY-DEGRADE.** In a full-suite run, if an earlier class
  sharing the app boot has opened the CHAT_AGENT breaker, the turn
  degrades to the unavailable string and an emptied-reply test passes
  vacuously. Mitigation: the restored IT asserts
  `testLlmProvider.callCount() >= 1` (TestLlmProvider.java:79) alongside
  the body assertions — a breaker-open turn never reaches the provider.
- **P5 — A blank check placed before step 9b suppresses lawful
  deterministic help delivery.** ChatAgent.java:591-614 appends the
  M1-665/666 deterministic blocks AFTER the sanitize/translate pipeline;
  checking `approved.isBlank()` upstream would degrade turns where a
  topic/command block matched — content whose emission AND bytes are
  deterministic end-to-end (security.md §LLM output sanitizer
  delivery-ordering contract path (a), :426-440). Mitigation: evaluate
  the empty check on the post-9b `reply`; skip the translator call on an
  already-blank `approved`.
- **P6 — Fixing only the `""` shape leaves the `"\n\n"+notice` shape.**
  The two shapes share one cause (emptied `reply`); a guard on the
  composed body alone misses the clarify turn, a guard on null-notice
  alone misses the normal turn. The source-level degrade covers both
  because the degrade returns a null notice (InboundRouter.java:1955-1956
  ships it verbatim). The IT's `assertNotEquals("\n\n" + notice, body)`
  plus a ChatAgent unit test pin both.
- **P7 — The default harness masks the defect (documented so it is not
  rediscovered).** StubEmbeddingProvider's single unit vector makes the
  step-3c probes match every turn; tests exercising emptied replies must
  clear the `'topic'`/`'command_intent'` doc_embedding rows (the parked
  IT's setUp already does, :84-85).
- **P8 — Suite isolation around the boot-built help corpora.** Two legs:
  (a) the restored IT's setUp DELETEs the corpus rows without restoring
  them, so full-suite ordering matters — the acceptance gate is repo-root
  `mvn verify` green (§5), and fallout is escalated, never papered over;
  (b) `InboundRouterChatModeIT.chatModeDispatchesToAgent`'s exact-body
  assertion is hostage to corpus presence / breaker state and fails in
  isolation (crosscheck log, Ground truth) — **FIXED by M1-796** (user
  decision 2026-08-08): its setUp gains the same corpus-clearing DELETE,
  test-only, making the 3c probes deterministically miss; verified no
  other ChatModeIT method reads the corpora (Ground truth). The fix must
  stay setUp-only — touching the assertion would be changing the test to
  match behavior (§8).
- **P9 — The spec amendment is parity-gated and rule-text-only.**
  docs/spec edits carry no `infochat.*` token without a real key
  (DocumentedConfigKeyParityTest; family P10 analog) and no dates/ticket
  IDs/report citations (engineering-rules §12); the user approves the
  exact wording (§12).
- **P10 — Closed list and sanitize() passes are frozen (family P11,
  carried).** No pass, no closed-list entry, no
  `LlmOutputSanitizerPostconditionTest` pin changes in this family — the
  `""`-return pin (:275-279) stays TRUE at the transform level after this
  family lands (the guard/substitute sit downstream), so it needs no flip.

## Solution options

- **A — Refuse at the placeholder finalize (route `finalizeInPlace`
  through a guard).** Rejected: violates messaging.md §Progress
  notifications' never-dangling guarantee (P2); the user watches
  "Working on it..." forever.
- **B — Refuse on the no-handle fresh leg and substitute nowhere.**
  Rejected: on adapters without message edit (the D31 collapse shape) or
  after an aborted placeholder send, refusal is user SILENCE — strictly
  worse than a deterministic fallback string, and spec-less.
- **C — Substitute at the source (ChatAgent degrade) + wire the
  fresh-send LLM leg through the seam (chosen, two tickets).** An emptied
  chat reply degrades exactly like the spec's other chat-agent failures:
  localized friendly error from the bundle (D43), null commit, null
  notice — derived from security.md §Failure handling (chat-mode,
  :1562-1566) read with §LLM output sanitizer's "strips or refuses"
  (:353-356) and messaging.md's never-dangling rule. The M1-794 seam is
  then wired into the one live LLM-authored fresh-send leg where refusal
  is the correct semantics (`deliverFresh`, /summary sections — no
  placeholder, no silence risk since sections cannot be blank).
- **D — Substitute at the router (`dispatchChatSelfDelivering`).**
  Rejected: P3 — the pending commit is already stashed; the emptied turn
  would persist.
- **E — A dedicated substitute bundle key instead of reusing
  `ERROR_CHAT_UNAVAILABLE`.** Rejected as the default: five-locale copy
  (D43) for a user-visible shape indistinguishable from a transient
  assistant failure; §1 favors reusing the existing degrade string. The
  exact wording rides the spec-amendment approval anyway (§12), so the
  user can still choose a dedicated key at implementation time.

## Chosen approach

Option C, decomposed as two independent tickets (no shared files, either
may land first; recommended order 796 → 795 so the user-visible defect
closes first):

- **M1-796 — the placeholder-leg substitution (owns the parked IT).**
  ChatAgent: after the 9b help-block composition (:591-614), if the
  composed `reply` is blank, return the degrade shape
  `ChatTurnResult(bundleLoader.get(ERROR_CHAT_UNAVAILABLE, scopeLanguage), null, null)`
  — mirroring the refusal intercept (:555-557); skip the step-9
  translator call on an already-blank `approved`. The placeholder then
  finalizes with deterministic localized copy (never blank, never
  bare-notice, never dangling — P2, P6), the turn is discarded with no
  `chat_session`/`chat_memory` write (P3), and deterministic help-block
  turns still deliver (P5). M1-796 also carries the test-only P8(b) fix:
  InboundRouterChatModeIT's setUp gains the corpus-clearing DELETE (user
  decision). Spec_refs: docs/spec/security.md §Failure
  handling; docs/spec/messaging.md §Progress notifications;
  docs/spec/llm.md §Failure handling (recap). The amendment recording the
  emptied-reply degrade row rides 796's diff (M1-779 precedent — the
  existing text already commits refusal, the chat-failure degrade shape,
  and never-dangling placeholders; the amendment records their
  combination), rule-text only, wording to the user (P9).
- **M1-795 — wire the seam into the live fresh-send leg.**
  `StageProgressNotifier.deliverFresh` (:289-292) routes through
  `OutboundDelivery.deliverLlmReply` instead of `deliver` — its only
  callers are the /summary LLM-prose section sends
  (SummaryCommandHandler.java:644,647). A blank section body is refused
  (WARN, no transport call) instead of shipped as an empty bubble; no
  placeholder exists on this leg, so refusal cannot dangle (P2
  inapplicable). `deliver`, `sendReply`, `terminate`, and the group paths
  stay untouched (P1; census dispositions in the ticket).
  Spec_refs: docs/spec/security.md §LLM output sanitizer;
  docs/spec/llm.md §Failure handling (recap).

Fixture calibration: 795's test pins `deliverFresh` refusal, 796's IT
pins the chat end state — neither pins a behavior the other changes.

## Controls to preserve (engineering-rules §10)

- The `](`-free outbound guarantee at the chokepoint

  through the same chokepoint; untouched.
- The sanitize() call and its audit rows upstream (ChatAgent.java:540) —
  untouched; no pass or closed-list change (P10).
- The M1-607 delivery-gated post-delivery commit
  (InboundRouter.java:1400-1403) — 796's degrade returns null
  `pendingCommit`, so `takePendingChatCommit()` is null and nothing
  persists; the gate itself is not re-parameterized.
- The D35 `/stop` stopped terminal (InboundRouter.java:1364-1371) —
  `reply == null` handling untouched; 796's degrade returns a non-null
  reply, never conflated with cancellation.
- The M1-665/666 deterministic help-block delivery (ChatAgent.java:591-614)
  — preserved by the post-9b check placement (P5).
- The M1-617 provenance notice composition (InboundRouter.java:1958-1962;
  pinned by ChatAgentProvenanceTest) — non-degrade turns compose
  byte-identically.
- ChatModeIT's ten test methods and every assertion in them — the P8(b)
  fix is setUp-only (a two-row DELETE plus comment), authorized by
  M1-796's acceptance item.
- `LlmOutputSanitizerPostconditionTest.deletionShapesMatchTheirDocumentedPostconditions`
  — UNCHANGED (P10; the pin documents the transform, not delivery).
- `OutboundDeliveryTest`'s M1-794 pins (`emptyBodyIsRefusedNotShipped`,
  `emptyBodyRefusalLogsRatherThanSending`, deterministic-empty
  deliverability) — UNCHANGED; 795 adds a caller-leg test, never edits

- Typing-off and adapter-metrics emission in `terminate`
  (StageProgressNotifier.java:340-351) — 795 does not touch `terminate`.

## Verification strategy

- P1 → M1-795: `StageProgressNotifierTest` failure-mode test feeds a
  blank body to `deliverFresh` (refused: no adapter send, WARN) AND a
  deliberately empty body through plain `deliver`/deterministic paths
  still shipping — M1-794's `OutboundDeliveryTest` pins run UNCHANGED.
- P2 → M1-796 IT: the finalized placeholder carries the substitute —
  `adapter.finalizedBodies()` is non-empty and non-blank; the placeholder
  never dangles (the await on a finalized terminal IS the dangle check).
- P3 → M1-796: ChatAgent unit test asserts the degrade returns null
  `pendingCommit` (nothing to persist) — plus the IT's drain of
  in-flight tasks with no `chat_session` row for the turn.
- P4 → restored IT asserts `testLlmProvider.callCount() >= 1`.
- P5 → M1-796: a turn whose prose empties but whose 3c probe matches a
  seeded topic still delivers the deterministic block (existing
  M1-665/666 tests run unchanged; none feed emptied prose — a new
  ChatAgent-level test pins the combination).
- P6 → the IT's two assertions (non-blank; not `"\n\n"+notice`) plus a
  ChatAgent unit test for the null-notice (clarify-shape) degrade.
- P7/P8 → full `mvn -B -pl infochat-provider -am verify` green from repo
  root; the corpus-clearing setUp is retained; P8(b) additionally gated
  by M1-796's isolation probe
  (`./mvnw -B -pl infochat-provider -am verify -Dit.test=InboundRouterChatModeIT -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false`,
  RED on main, GREEN after the setUp fix).
- Every new test names a mutation of the diff's own code it catches
  (non-vacuity): reverting the `deliverFresh` routing fails 795's test;
  removing the ChatAgent blank check fails 796's IT; reverting the
  ChatModeIT setUp DELETE re-reds the isolation probe.

## Decomposition

1. **M1-796 — empty-body placeholder substitution** (recommended first;
   closes the user-visible defect). Files: ChatAgent.java,
   ChatAgentTest.java (or a focused new test class),
   `.scratch/parked-for-M1-795/EmptyLlmReplyDeliveryIT.java` → restored
   in-tree, InboundRouterChatModeIT.java (setUp-only P8(b) fix, test-only),
   docs/spec/llm.md (amendment riding the diff).
2. **M1-795 — wire the guard into the live fresh-send leg.** Files:
   StageProgressNotifier.java, StageProgressNotifierTest.java. Carries the
   delivery-leg census (class-scoped guard ticket).

No `blocked_by` edges between them (disjoint files, disjoint behaviors);
both are unblocked today (M1-794 done — brief discrepancy noted in Ground
truth).

## SPEC-GAP

None. The spec already commits every leg of the chosen behavior:
sanitizer "strips or refuses" (security.md:353-356), chat-mode LLM
failure → localized bundle friendly error + discarded turn
(security.md:1562-1566), placeholders never dangle
(messaging.md:220-222), deterministic strings come from the bundle (D43,
llm.md:347-353). M1-796's amendment records the emptied-reply instance of
these rules — a rides-the-diff record (M1-779 precedent), not a promise
change; the exact wording goes to the user at implementation time (§12).
